description: Narrow correctness repair for two malformed active Paper Hero's Huntington Beach weekly recurrence records that used legacy weekday strings instead of numeric dayOfWeek values.
author: Codex Project Steward
applied_notes: Applied only the two recurrence JSON corrections. Default start times and all other event_series fields were preserved. Post-write readback confirmed Friday dayOfWeek 5 and Saturday dayOfWeek 6.

operations.reason: The app's occurrence construction expects weekly recurrence.dayOfWeek to be numeric. The prior recurrence used {"weekday":"friday","frequency":"weekly"}, which could cause an unbounded weekday-search loop.

The app's occurrence construction expects weekly recurrence.dayOfWeek to be numeric. The prior recurrence used {"weekday":"saturday","frequency":"weekly"}, which could cause an unbounded weekday-search loop.

validation: Read back both repaired event_series rows from Supabase.
Confirmed zero active weekly event_series rows remain with legacy weekday-only recurrence.
Confirmed zero active weekly event_series rows remain with invalid dayOfWeek.
Projected live Supabase event_series through the guarded recurrence path without invalid weekly skips.
